description: An English retelling that keeps the folktale’s rustic Norwegian setting and dry, blunt humor, following a poor farmer who vows not to return until he finds three wives as foolish as his own—after she is tricked by a butcher, tarred and feathered, and later salts a ploughed field in earnest hope.
summary: A fed-up farmer roams the road to prove his wife isn’t the only fool in the countryside.
